message: Wow -- thanks, likewise, for the comment, Thomas! I'm glad I was able to do the book some justice. And it looks like [the conversations you've started](http://www.mediatedtdez.com/cgi-bin/yabb/YaBB.cgi) might be really helpful to me in fleshing out some of [my ideas](http://www.vitia.org/paris.html) about online identity formation and economic commodification.
